About e-Pulse

A distributor management system for pharmaceutical supply chains, covering inventory, sales, purchasing, accounts and head-office oversight.

What the product is

e-Pulse is a web application for pharmaceutical distributors. It keeps stock at batch level with expiry dates, connects purchase and sales documents to the stock ledger, and posts documents to accounts so inventory and finance stay consistent.

It is organised as a Distributor portal for day-to-day operations, an Admin portal for head-office oversight, and an optional ERP integration layer. The application also runs fully standalone.

Company information

Editable content. Company history, leadership, certifications and customer information have not been supplied and are intentionally not stated. Edit src/public/pages/About.jsx and the VITE_COMPANY_* settings to add verified details.

Distributor portal

Inventory and batches, sales and purchase documents, returns, accounts and claims for a single Distributor.

Admin portal

Dashboard, distributor management, secondary sales, schemes, claims, finance views and ERP integration. Separate sign-in and session.

There is no separate retailer portal; retailers are master-data records managed by Distributors and Admin.
